sloka: गजग्रैवेयकक्ष्याश्च रथभाण्डाश्च संस्कृताः।तनुत्राणि च योधानां हस्त्यश्वानां च वर्म च ।। ६.७५.१० ।।
transliteration: gajagraiveyakakṣyāśca rathabhāṇḍāśca saṁskṛtāḥ।tanutrāṇi ca yodhānāṁ hastyaśvānāṁ ca varma ca ।। 6.75.10 ।।

translations.english: Different kinds of peculiar kinds of ornaments used to decorate horses, ornaments worn round the neck and girths of elephants, and polished chariot decorations.
